name: Jurassic Blocky
desc:
🦖 Welcome to Jurassic Blocky, an open-world PvP dinosaur battleground! Spawn as a your favorite dinosaur or one of our team's original creations, master its abilities, and fight other players. Can you become the strongest?

⭐ Favorite + 👍 like the game to support development!

Battle as famous dinosaurs & exclusive custom designs
Unique heavy attacks on supported dinosaurs
Team up to take down powerful world bosses
Unlock skins and customize your look
Dynamic weather & day cycles
Earn coins from combat and prove you're the strongest

❗ Private servers do NOT grant coins or PvP rewards.
🛠️ Updates have no set dates — they release when they're ready!
